newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait six-month T-bill rate eases to 7.184 pct.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait six-month T-bill rate eases to 7.184 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for 60 million dinars of six-month Kuwait treasury bills edged down to 7.184 percent from 7.189 percent last week, official figures show.
The bills are offered on Mondays and issued on Wednesdays. The average accepted price was 96.558.
The highest accepted price was 96.540, with a yield of 7.188 percent. The lowest accepted price was 96.627, with a yield of 7.001 percent.
